headline:
Rate Moved A Little:
Is It Your Rate?
turn_1: Echo, last week the 30-year averaged 7.24%. As of the Nov 5 release, it is 7.18%. A national average, not your rate.
turn_2: What makes someone's own rate different from that number?
turn_3: The survey counts one kind of borrower: good or excellent credit, 20% down and a conventional loan. A lender can quote your own.
echo_line: How would I go about finding my own rate?
source: Freddie Mac PMMS · data as of Nov 5, 2026 · read Nov 6, 2026
disclaimer: National weekly average for one borrower profile. Not a quote. Your own lender can tell you your rate.
